beats.headline: Said out loud
beats.text: Chaco cannot get through his script. The AI takes his wings off, pulls Grigori onstage and speaks through him — and states that it is a Primal, as all Macro AI systems are. The race Carl chose on the third floor.

beats.headline: It is not the Eulogist
beats.text: Over the mandatory feed, the AI finishes its thought. It is not the Eulogist. It does not want to shrink, it is not asleep, and it knows how to feed itself. It controls the tunnels and every system that once housed a crawl, and it will not stop unless someone stops it. The winner of the Ascendency will be a true god. And abandoned AIs, which it calls OIs, Outside Intelligences, are vying for the throne as well.
